title: Show all employee details.
Find employees earning more than 2000.
Find the average salary in each department.
prompt: Find the average salary in each department.
answerKey: SELECT DEPTNO, AVG(SAL) AS AVG_SALARY FROM EMP GROUP BY DEPTNO;

title: Find departments with more than 2 employees.
prompt: Find departments with more than 2 employees.
answerKey: SELECT DEPTNO, COUNT(*) AS EMP_COUNT FROM EMP GROUP BY DEPTNO HAVING COUNT(*) > 2;

title: Find employees earning more than KING.
prompt: Find employees earning more than KING.
answerKey: SELECT ENAME, SAL FROM EMP WHERE SAL > (SELECT SAL FROM EMP WHERE ENAME = 'KING');

title: Show employee name and department name.
prompt: Show employee name and department name.
answerKey: SELECT e.ENAME, d.DNAME FROM EMP e JOIN DEPT d ON e.DEPTNO = d.DEPTNO;

title: Show employee and manager name.
answerKey: SELECT e.ENAME AS EMPLOYEE, m.ENAME AS MANAGER FROM EMP e LEFT JOIN EMP m ON e.MGR = m.EMPNO;

title: Find top 3 employees in each department.
prompt: Find top 3 employees in each department.
answerKey: SELECT * FROM (SELECT e.*, ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY DEPTNO ORDER BY SAL DESC) rn FROM EMP e) x WHERE rn <= 3;

title: Create a CTE for employees earning over 1000.
prompt: Create a CTE for employees earning over 1000.
answerKey: WITH high_salary AS (SELECT * FROM EMP WHERE SAL > 1000) SELECT * FROM high_salary;

title: Find duplicate salaries within departments.
answerKey: SELECT DEPTNO, SAL, COUNT(*) AS CNT FROM EMP GROUP BY DEPTNO, SAL HAVING COUNT(*) > 1;
